meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 接手 `migrate-v2.sh` 跑完后的收尾：读取交接记录、给 owner 赋角色、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置、搬运 fork 定制代码。
howto.when: 当你说 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration”、“v1 migration” 等关键词时触发；前提是 `migrate-v2.sh` 已跑完、`handoff.json` 已存在。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾
say.note: 先检查 handoff.json，没有就让你先跑脚本

say.text: 把 owner 角色授予我
say.note: 确认用户后写入 owner 角色

say.text: 把我的 v1 定制内容迁过来
say.note: 进入 Phase 4，按提交逐项搬运

howto.what_en: Picks up after migrate-v2.sh finishes: reads the handoff log, grants the owner role, runs the legacy memory migration, reconciles container configs, and ports fork customizations.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration" or "v1 migration" once migrate-v2.sh has run and handoff.json exists.

say_en.text: Finish the v1 to v2 migration for me

say_en.note: Writes owner role after you confirm the user
Enters Phase 4 and walks the commits
